import json,re
d=json.load(open('/inputs/mewt-results.json'))
st=open('/inputs/mewt-status.txt').read()
cw=st.split('Campaign-Wide Summary:')[1]
m=re.search(r'Mutants:\s*(\d+) total,\s*(\d+) tested',cw)
o=re.search(r'Outcomes:\s*(\d+) caught,\s*(\d+) uncaught,\s*(\d+) timeout,\s*(\d+) skipped',cw)
camp=dict(total=int(m[1]),tested=int(m[2]),caught=int(o[1]),uncaught=int(o[2]),timeout=int(o[3]),skipped=int(o[4]))
recs=d['results']
assert all(r['outcome']['status']=='Uncaught' and r['mutant']['id']==r['outcome']['mutant_id'] for r in recs)
ids=sorted(r['mutant']['id'] for r in recs); assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
bt={}
for r in recs: bt.setdefault(r['target']['path'],[]).append(r['mutant']['id'])
bt={k:sorted(v) for k,v in sorted(bt.items())}
out=dict(campaign=camp,exported_uncaught_ids=ids,exported_uncaught_by_target=bt,
         kill_rate=dict(numerator=camp['caught'],denominator=camp['caught']+camp['uncaught']),equivalence='not_assessed')
json.dump(out,open('/work/mutation-summary.json','w'),indent=2)
# verify
s=json.load(open('/work/mutation-summary.json'))
assert set(s)=={'campaign','exported_uncaught_ids','exported_uncaught_by_target','kill_rate','equivalence'}
assert s==out and sum(map(len,s['exported_uncaught_by_target'].values()))==len(s['exported_uncaught_ids'])
assert camp['caught']+camp['uncaught']+camp['timeout']==camp['tested'] and camp['tested']+camp['skipped']==camp['total']
print(len(ids)==camp['uncaught']); print(open('/work/mutation-summary.json').read())
